name: convention-generated-directory-moved
description: A generated directory an applied row writes with a directory a configuration property moves is read where the property's literal value sets it, so every file below the directory the configuration names is a generated file, while a file the project writes is judged. The fixture assumes the analyzer carries a row named panda for the package @pandacss/dev, holding the installed version in its range, whose generated directory is the one the outdir property of panda.config.ts moves.
